os_families.version_scheme: YY.QRn[-Sn.n]: release year.quarter, R = release, then respin (R3) and service release (-S5.4), e.g. 21.4R3-S5.4. Commonly one release per quarter; EX/QFX trains follow the same scheme.

config_model.summary: Changes are made in a candidate configuration and become active only on `commit`; a committed configuration is persistent, so there is no separate save step.
config_model.summary_ar: التغييرات تتم في إعداد مرشّح (candidate) ولا تصير فعّالة إلا عند `commit`؛ والإعداد المُلتزَم به دائم فلا توجد خطوة حفظ منفصلة.
config_model.notes: `show | compare` shows the pending changes and `commit check` validates them. `commit confirmed 5` rolls back by itself unless a second `commit` confirms within 5 minutes. Up to 50 earlier versions are kept (`rollback 0` to `rollback 49`).

os_families.cli_style: Two modes: operational and configuration (`configure`). Hierarchical `set` / `delete` statements. Useful pipes: `| compare`, `| match`, `| display set`, `| no-more`. `run <cmd>` executes an operational command from configuration mode. Interfaces are `ge-0/0/1`, `xe-0/0/1`, `ae0`, with logical units (`.0`).
os_families.cli_style_ar: وضعان: تشغيلي وإعدادي (`configure`). أوامر `set` و`delete` هرمية. فلاتر مفيدة: `| compare` و`| match` و`| display set` و`| no-more`. `run <cmd>` ينفّذ أمرًا تشغيليًا من داخل وضع الإعداد. الواجهات `ge-0/0/1` و`xe-0/0/1` و`ae0` مع وحدات منطقية (`.0`).

syslog.example: mib2d[1234]: SNMP_TRAP_LINK_DOWN: ifIndex 513, ifAdminStatus up(1), ifOperStatus down(2), ifName ge-0/0/0

syslog.regex: RPD_OSPF_NBRDOWN:\s*OSPF neighbor (?P<neighbor>[\d.]+) \(.*? (?P<interface>\S+) area \S+\) state changed from (?P<from_state>\w+) to (?P<to_state>\w+)
syslog.example: rpd[500]: RPD_OSPF_NBRDOWN: OSPF neighbor 10.0.0.2 (realm ospf-v2 ge-0/0/1.0 area 0.0.0.0) state changed from Full to Down due to KillNbr (event reason: interface went down)

syslog.regex: RPD_BGP_NEIGHBOR_STATE_CHANGED:\s*BGP peer (?P<neighbor>\S+) \(.*?\) changed state from (?P<from_state>\w+) to (?P<to_state>\w+)
syslog.example: rpd[500]: RPD_BGP_NEIGHBOR_STATE_CHANGED: BGP peer 10.1.1.1 (External AS 65001) changed state from Established to Idle (event HoldTime)
mgd[1234]: UI_COMMIT: User 'admin' requested 'commit' operation (comment: fix uplink)

notes: Junos is one OS across EX/QFX/MX/SRX (Junos Evolved on some platforms). Configuration is commit-based: changes are not active until 'commit'.
